items.exampleEn: I don't like movies with a lot of blood.
items.exampleZh: 我不喜歡有很多血腥畫面的電影。
游泳是很好的身體運動。

items.exampleEn: What is the weight of this box?

items.exampleZh: 她在乾燥的嘴唇上擦了點乳霜。

items.exampleEn: The accident happened at a busy corner.
items.exampleZh: 事故發生在一個繁忙的路口。

items.exampleEn: The baby fell asleep on her father's chest.
items.exampleZh: 寶寶在爸爸的胸口上睡著了。

items.exampleEn: My uncle stopped buying cigarettes last year.
items.exampleZh: 我叔叔去年就不再買菸了。

items.exampleEn: My stomach makes noises when I'm hungry.
items.exampleZh: 我肚子餓的時候會咕嚕咕嚕叫。

items.audioEn: I lost some weight because I walk to work every day.
items.audioZh: 我瘦了一點，因為我每天走路上班。
items.questionZh: 說話的人為什麼變瘦了？

items.sentenceEn: Please don't throw cigarettes on the street.
items.sentenceZh: 請不要把菸蒂丟在街上。

items.sentenceEn: Physical work makes me very tired.

items.stemEn: Put your hand on your ____. Can you feel your heart?
items.stemZh: 把手放在胸口上，你感覺得到心跳嗎？

items.passageEn: Last winter, Ben's family went to the mountains. The temperature was very low, and Ben's lips were dry from the cold wind. On the way down, they saw an accident: a car hit a tree, but the driver was fine. That evening, they ate hot soup at a small restaurant, and Ben's stomach felt warm and full.
items.passageZh: 去年冬天，Ben 一家人去山上。氣溫非常低，冷風吹得 Ben 嘴唇都乾了。下山的路上，他們看到一起事故：一輛車撞到了樹，不過駕駛沒事。那天晚上，他們在一家小餐廳喝熱湯，Ben 的肚子覺得又暖又飽。

questions.questionZh: Ben 的嘴唇為什麼很乾？
他們在下山的路上看到什麼？

items.instructionZh: 用 physical 造一個句子，說說你做的身體活動，或需要勞力的工作。
referenceEn: I like physical activities like hiking.
My job needs a lot of physical work.
rubricZh: physical 放在名詞前，表示「身體的」（例如 physical activities、physical work）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 My job needs）
